subject: short layered male hair, front view (D = pupil line to chin)
reference_style: Monster Hunter Stories 3 (MHS3) anime toon style, adult male (Leo, official render)

silhouette.reference: Hair mass top 1.35 D above the pupils with a few spikes to 1.5 D standing up from the crown; hair half width 0.80 D at the temples; jagged pointed outline.
silhouette.ours: Hair top 1.40 D above the pupils, a rounded mass with small spikes at the crown; hair half width 0.96 D at the temples; outline rounded with pointed tips at the bottom.

fringe.reference: A few big pointed clumps fall from the top over the forehead; the longest central clumps reach the brows and touch the top of the eyes (about 0.06 D above the pupils), swept slightly to one side, overlapping.
fringe.ours: Six big pointed clumps plus two short ones fall over the forehead; the longest reach the brows and the top of the eyes (about 0.0-0.1 D above the pupils), swept slightly to one side, overlapping.

clumps.reference: Chunky flat clumps with pointed tips and thin dark lines between them; clumps are wide (about 0.25 D) on top.
clumps.ours: Chunky clumps with pointed tips and dark lines between them; clumps about 0.3 D wide on top, many parallel clumps visible on the sides.

colour.reference: Warm light brown, median sRGB (155,118,82), lights up to (202,164,131); a few sharp pale highlight strokes on the top; darker brown under the fringe.
colour.ours: Warm brown, median sRGB (113,81,57), lights up to (187,141,111) at the clump tips; light vertical streaks on several clumps; dark brown under the fringe.

sides_back.reference: Sides stop above the ears; short pointed layers at the back.
sides_back.ours: Sides stop above the ears; short pointed layers at the back ending at about ear-bottom level.
